newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Gross yield in Czech CNB 13-wk bill auction drops.
newsitem.headline: Gross yield in Czech CNB 13-wk bill auction drops.

text.p: Gross yield in a Czech National Bank (CNB) auction of 13-week liquidity bills dropped to 12.0 percent from 12.2 percent in a similar auction last week, the CNB said on Thursday.
The auction offering five billion worth of bills was oversubscribed by 3.3 billion, the CNB said. Net yield reached nine percent. Maximum yield set by the CNB for the auction was 12.2 percent.
The three month Prague interbank offered rate (PRIBOR) stood at 12.36 percent on Thursday, down one basis point from Wednesday.
